now.title: WandaVision
now.text: In episode 7, back from the Blip, Monica enters the Westview Hex for S.W.O.R.D. and gains powers.

proposed.text: In episode 7, defying Director Hayward, Monica forces her way back into the Westview Hex and gains powers.

changes.evidence: In WandaVision episode 7 Monica has been cut off by Hayward; she and Jimmy get a vehicle from S.W.O.R.D. personnel loyal to her late mother rather than Director Hayward, and when it fails she crosses the barrier herself and gains powers. She is acting against S.W.O.R.D.'s leadership, not for S.W.O.R.D.

now.title: The Marvels
now.text: Goose and her kittens swallow the crew of Fury's space station to save them.
cases: ST-113 The Attack on the Sun (The Marvels)

proposed.text: Goose lays a litter of Flerken kittens on Fury's space station, and Fury uses them to swallow the crew and carry them to safety. Goose then settles on Earth with Carol.

changes.evidence: In The Marvels the kittens, not Goose, swallow the S.A.B.E.R. agents ('Goose watched over her children as they ate up all of the agents'); Goose then takes an escape pod to Earth and ends the film living with Carol at the Rambeau house, so 'Off-world' (F3) is also wrong.
